title: Name bands playing the 'Bama State campus
summary: Hines, Basie with the Moten band and Hot Lips Page played on campus and the Collegians alternated with them.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: That's what I was wondering. When the bands came through, like Earl Hines and the others, where did they play?
They played on the campus, at school.
Right. They had, and they had special, they have a dance. I know when they came to Montgomery. That's where they played,

on the campus, at 'Bama State.
And then 'Bama State Collegians,
which I was in, we used to alternate with them.
All the bands used to come in, even Count Basie,
and was with Benny Moten at that time. He took
the band over then later.
So, they came. Hot Lips Page and all them was with the band.
